onboardOrg.title: Get started
onboardOrg.subtitle: You're not a member of any organization yet. Create one, or join an existing one with an invite.
onboardOrg.subtitleAs: You're signed in as {{email}} but not a member of any organization yet. Create one, or join an existing one with an invite.
onboardOrg.inviteDesc: Paste the invite code an organization admin sent you.
onboardOrg.orgIdDesc: 2-40 characters, lowercase letters and digits, starting with a letter. It becomes the schema name and the subdomain, and cannot be changed later.
onboardOrg.includeDemoDesc: Seed the new organization with sample sources so you can explore right away.
onboardOrg.isolatedEngineDesc: Run this organization on its own dedicated federation engine instead of the shared cluster.
onboardOrg.emailRuleDesc: A regular expression an invitee's email must match to join, e.g. "@acme\.com$". Leave blank to allow any email.
onboardOrg.autoJoinDesc: Any new account whose email matches the rule above joins automatically with the role below — no invite needed.
onboardOrg.autoJoinRoleDesc: The role granted on auto-join, e.g. a read-only "analyst".
onboardOrg.autoJoinBreadthTitle: This rule reaches past your domain
onboardOrg.autoJoinAcceptRisk: I have reviewed this rule and accept that it may admit people from outside my organization
onboardOrg.provisioning: Provisioning your organization. This can take a moment...
onboardOrg.provisionTimeout: Provisioning did not complete in time
onboardOrg.egressCheckoutFailed: Could not open the data transfer subscription checkout. Add it later from Billing.
onboardOrg.welcomeAdmin: Congratulations — your organization is ready and you are its administrator.
onboardOrg.welcomeInviteBody: Open Team to create an invite link and choose the role each person receives when they join. Send them the link — signing in with it makes them a member of your organization.
onboardOrg.welcomeGrantBody: Privileges come from roles. As administrator you decide what each role can do and who gets it:
onboardOrg.welcomeGrantStep1: In Security → Roles, create roles and pick their capabilities and domains.
onboardOrg.welcomeGrantStep2: In Team, choose that role when you invite someone so they receive those privileges on joining.
onboardOrg.pendingInvitesBody: Someone invited you to join an organization. Accept it to get in, or create your own organization below.
onboardOrg.signUpDesc: Creating an organization starts your Starter trial. We take your card now; nothing is charged until the trial converts.
onboardOrg.planDesc: Every plan bills by the engine hour against a monthly minimum — the minimum is drawn against, not added to.
onboardOrg.planEgress: {{gb}} GB of query results a month included, then {{amount}} per GB
onboardOrg.planTrial: {{days}}-day free trial — card taken now, nothing charged until it converts
onboardOrg.planNoTrial: No trial on this size; billing starts with your first invoice
onboardOrg.planTrialSpent: Your free trial has already been used; billing starts with your first invoice
onboardOrg.signUpDescPaid: Creating an organization opens checkout for the plan you chose. Billing starts immediately on this size.
onboardOrg.resumeBody: You started signing up for {{name}} but did not finish checkout. The name is held until {{expires}}.
onboardOrg.checkoutNotSettled: Your payment has not reached us yet. Reload this page in a minute to finish setting up your organization.

autoJoinChoiceTitle: More than one org matches your email
autoJoinChoiceBody: Your email address matches the join rules of several organizations. Pick the one you belong to, or turn them all down and create your own.
